summary: The EPFL School of Life Sciences Summer Research Program is an eight-week research stay in Lausanne, Switzerland, from July 5 to August 27, 2027. It is for Bachelor and first-year Master students enrolled in a life sciences field who have a minimum GPA equivalent to 3.75/4.0 or rank in the top 5% of their class.
highlights: For Bachelor and first-year Master students enrolled in a life sciences field.
Minimum GPA equivalent to 3.75/4.0, or top 5% of class.
Eight weeks of research, from July 5 to August 27, 2027, in Lausanne.
